selection: All explicit reviewed red/blue positives with current CC BY 2.0 photo-page verification. Background subset in crop SHA256 order with fixed caps. No classifier-driven mining or held-out selection.
background_overlap_policy: Exclude every unmatched proposal labeled background if its padded crop intersects any source balloon annotation. An unmatched proposal is not proof of background, even at low IoU.
controls: Same ordinary rows, extra class counts, order, weights and epochs; extra examples sampled from existing same-class TRAIN crops with fixed RNG47.
loss: Hard cross-entropy plus 0.5 parent KL at T=4 on ordinary rows only; hard extra rows have weight4 in both arms.
checkpoint_policy: Final epoch24 only, no intermediate checkpoint selection
development_plan: Compare both seeds and matched controls to unchanged parent on all three existing frozen development panels, threshold0.8 IoU0.5, mser_confirmed_parts, split_merged, aspect2.42913421076193. No threshold sweep or qualification claim.
